title: Midbus! 🔥
description: “The mighty Midbus is ready for battle!” 💪
body:
“The mighty Midbus is ready for battle!” 💪


From Mario & Luigi: Bowser’s Inside Story, the loyal enforcer of **Fawful, Midbus**, storms into **Minecraft** with his full strength and attitude! ⚔️


This **resource pack** features:


🧱 **A fully custom 3D model and textures** faithful to his original design


🎞️ **Unique attack and defense animations** inspired by his battle against Bowser


🔊 Authentic sound effects and voice lines from the original game


🔗 His signature **spiked ball and chain**, recreated as part of his combat moves


Prepare yourself — the arena trembles as Midbus enters the fight! 💥


**///About Mod///**

This is an altered version of the original model made by YoshiMaker of Boom Boom,
which replaces him with Midbus.

[https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M](https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M)

-Custom texture pack (x16)

-Models made in Blockbench

-Download the required packs for non missing textures

-Inspiration straight from Mario and Luigi Bowser Inside Story

-You need the [https://modrinth.com/mod/mario-mania/version/2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/mario-mania/version/2.0)

-Also [https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/ApKEGN4z](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/ApKEGN4z)

-And also [https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator/version/1.0.2+1.19.4-forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator/version/1.0.2+1.19.4-forge)
